full_judgment: 2. The short fact leading to this petition is that the petitioners as plaintiffs earlier instituted Title Suit No. 177 of 1994 in the Court of the Subordinate Judge, Dhaka for declaration of their title and partition of the suit properties. That suit on contest was dismissed by the trial Court which decree was affirmed up to the Appellate Division where a review petition was also filed which too was rejected. The petitioners then instituted Title Suit No. 42 of 1999 in the 5th Court of the Subordinate Judge, Dhaka praying for declaration that the decree passed in earlier Title Suit No. 177 of 1994 is illegal and invalid and is not applicable in respect of 'Ga' schedule land of the present suit. Their further prayer is that the land described in 'Kha' schedule measuring about 94 decimals was purchased by defendant No. 1 from defendant Nos. 2 to 6 and these defendants filed an application under Order 7 rule 11 read with Order 14 rule 2 of the Code of Civil Procedure for rejection of the plaint or in the alternative for hearing on law point first which prayer was rejected by the learned Subordinate Judge by Order dated 27-7-1999. The present petitioners 40 in number previously filed Title Suit No. 92 of 1991 which was subsequently re-numbered as Title Suit No. 177 of 1994 wherein they prayed for declaration of title in respect of 'Ka' and 'Ka' schedule land and for partition. In that suit defendant Nos. 2 to 7 of the present suit were also defendants. With regard to schedule 'Ka' land of the earlier suit there was no dispute but dispute is only in respect of 'Kha' schedule land of the previous suit for self-same plaintiffs filed the present suit. In the 'Kha' schedule land of the plaint of the earlier suit under plot No. 371 of CS Khatian No. 4300 (Jha) area was shown as 94 Satangsha and the plaintiffs claimed that out of 94 Satangsha defendants purchased only 0090 Ajutangsha by several documents in the year 1954-55 and since the defendants purchased a small portion of land by several documents, the plaintiffs prayed for declaration of title as well as partition in the earlier suit. In the previous suit the plaintiffs claimed that the defendants purchased 0090 Ajutangsha land but the claim of the defendants was that they purchased 94 Ajutangsha. In the earlier suit defendants claimed entire CS plot No. 371 and they mutated their names and they are in possession all through. And in that suit the trial Court as well as the appellate Court on consideration of the materials on record found that the defendants purchased the entire land measuring 90 Satangsha. The plaintiff in that suit tried to prove that CS plot contained 94 decimals of land on production of CS Khatian which the trial Court as well as the High Court Division found to be forged and fabricated and ultimately the suit filed by plaintiffs was dismissed by the trial Court which was upheld upto the Appellate Division. It is now the case of the plaintiffs in the present suit that after dismissal of the earlier suit upto the Appellate Division the defendants of that suit who are defendant Nos. 2 to 6 in the present suit sold land measuring .90 Satangsha of CS Plot No. 371 to defendant No. 1 by registered Kabala which is the cause of action of the present suit.
